corinthians2.7.p1.b1.text: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

corinthians2.7.p1.b2.text: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

corinthians2.7.p1.b3.text: …I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.

corinthians2.7.p2.b1.text: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.

corinthians2.7.p2.b2.text: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,

corinthians2.7.p2.b3.text: …He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.

corinthians2.7.p3.b1.text: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it…

corinthians2.7.p3.b2.text: And now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance…

corinthians2.7.p3.b3.text: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret…

corinthians2.7.p4.b1.text: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication!

corinthians2.7.p4.b2.text: In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

corinthians2.7.p4.b3.text: So even though I wrote to you…your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.

corinthians2.7.p5.b1.text: On account of this, we are encouraged…

corinthians2.7.p5.b2.text: …In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

corinthians2.7.p5.b3.text: …just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.

corinthians2.7.p6.b1.text: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

corinthians2.7.p6.b2.text: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
